retain.text:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Retain already signed qualification from an authorized disposable-target run.
# This command never creates a qualification statement or loads a signing key.
set -euo pipefail
[[ $# -ge 3 ]] || { echo "usage: $0 candidate-directory root-public-key CELL [CELL ...]" >&2; exit 2; }
directory=$1
root=$2
shift 2
source_revision=$(jq -er '.source_revision' "$directory/qualification.json")
run_id=$(jq -er '.verification.run_id' "$directory/qualification.json")
[[ $source_revision =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ && $run_id =~ ^[1-9][0-9]{0,17}$ ]] || exit 2
tag=ci-$source_revision-run-$run_id
work=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf -- "$work"' EXIT
arguments=()
for cell in "$@"; do
    [[ $cell =~ ^[A-Z]{3}$ ]] || exit 2
    arguments+=(--cell "$cell")
done
# Admission binds both exact binary digests, build manifest, scope and evidence.
dist/ts-orch release verify-production --dir "$directory" --root-key "$root" "${arguments[@]}"
gh release download "$tag" --repo TerraScale/ts-orchestrator --pattern qualification.json --output "$work/qualification.json" >/dev/null
cmp -- "$directory/qualification.json" "$work/qualification.json"
gh release view "$tag" --repo TerraScale/ts-orchestrator --json assets > "$work/assets.json"
retain() {
    local name=$1 path=$2
    if [[ ! -e $work/$name ]] && ! jq -e --arg name "$name" 'any(.assets[]; .name == $name)' "$work/assets.json" >/dev/null; then
        cp -- "$path" "$work/$name"
        gh release upload "$tag" "$work/$name" --repo TerraScale/ts-orchestrator
    fi
    gh release download "$tag" --repo TerraScale/ts-orchestrator --pattern "$name" --output "$work/readback" >/dev/null
    cmp -- "$path" "$work/readback"
    rm -- "$work/readback"
}
for cell in "$@"; do
    for architecture in amd64 arm64; do
        record=$directory/production/$cell/$architecture/production.json
        jq -er '.payload.evidence[].sha256 | select(test("^[0-9a-f]{64}$"))' "$record" > "$work/digests"
        while IFS= read -r digest; do
            retain "production-evidence-$digest" "$directory/production/objects/$digest"
        done < "$work/digests"
        delegation=$directory/production/$cell/$architecture/delegation.json
        if [[ -f $delegation ]]; then
            retain "production-$cell-$architecture-delegation.json" "$delegation"
        fi
        # Signed records are completion markers, after evidence object readback.
        retain "production-$cell-$architecture.json" "$record"
    done
done

fetch.text:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Fetch retained evidence; only release verify-production grants admission.
set -euo pipefail
[[ $# == 2 && $1 =~ ^ci-[0-9a-f]{40}-run-[1-9][0-9]{0,17}$ ]] || {
    echo "usage: $0 ci-SHA-run-ID candidate-directory" >&2; exit 2;
}
tag=$1
directory=$2/production
mkdir -p "$directory/objects"
work=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf -- "$work"' EXIT
gh release view "$tag" --repo TerraScale/ts-orchestrator --json assets > "$work/assets.json"
# Never construct a path from unvalidated release metadata or envelope fields.
fetch() {
    local name=$1 output=$2 limit=$3
    jq -e --arg name "$name" --argjson limit "$limit" \
        '[.assets[] | select(.name == $name)] | length == 1 and all(.size > 0 and .size <= $limit)' \
        "$work/assets.json" >/dev/null || return 1
    gh release download "$tag" --repo TerraScale/ts-orchestrator --pattern "$name" --output "$output" >/dev/null || return 1
    [[ -f $output && ! -L $output && $(stat -c '%s' "$output") -le $limit ]]
}
jq -r '.assets[].name | select(test("^production-[A-Z]{3}-(amd64|arm64)\\.json$"))' \
    "$work/assets.json" > "$work/records"
while IFS= read -r name; do
    [[ $name =~ ^production-([A-Z]{3})-(amd64|arm64)\.json$ ]] || exit 2
    cell=${BASH_REMATCH[1]}
    architecture=${BASH_REMATCH[2]}
    target=$directory/$cell/$architecture
    mkdir -p "$target"
    if ! fetch "$name" "$target/production.json" 1064960; then
        echo "$cell $architecture: retained production record unavailable" >&2
        continue
    fi
    delegation=production-$cell-$architecture-delegation.json
    if jq -e --arg name "$delegation" 'any(.assets[]; .name == $name)' "$work/assets.json" >/dev/null; then
        if ! fetch "$delegation" "$target/delegation.json" 1064960; then
            # An advertised but unavailable delegation must never become root-signed admission.
            printf '{}\n' > "$target/delegation.json"
        fi
    fi
    if ! jq -er '.payload.evidence | select(length == 2) | .[] |
        select((.sha256 | test("^[0-9a-f]{64}$")) and (.bytes > 0 and .bytes <= 67108864)) |
        [.sha256, (.bytes | tostring)] | @tsv' "$target/production.json" > "$work/objects"; then
        echo "$cell $architecture: malformed retained evidence references" >&2
        continue
    fi
    while IFS=$'\t' read -r digest bytes; do
        [[ $digest =~ ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ && $bytes =~ ^[1-9][0-9]*$ ]] || continue
        object=$directory/objects/$digest
        if [[ ! -f $object ]]; then
            if ! fetch "production-evidence-$digest" "$object" "$bytes"; then
                rm -f -- "$object"
                echo "$cell $architecture: retained evidence $digest unavailable" >&2
            fi
        fi
    done < "$work/objects"
done < "$work/records"

run.text:
// Package cli provides the release commands of the unified orchestrator executable.
package cli

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"io"

	"github.com/TerraScale/ts-orchestrator/internal/commandio"
)

const usage = `Usage: ts-orch release <command> [flags]

Commands:
  run-detail
  verify-production
  verify-image-production
  apply
  sign-delegation
  binary-candidate
  sign-binary
  verify-binary
  image-candidate
  sign-image
  verify-image
  publish
  sign-update-delegation
  sign-binary-update
  sign-spec-delegation
  sign-spec
  sign-root-rotation
  deploy
  service-deploy
  fleet-status
`

type command struct {
	ctx    context.Context
	output io.Writer
}

// Run executes a release command without starting the controller or host agent.
func Run(ctx context.Context, args []string, output io.Writer) error {
	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	writer := commandio.NewWriter(output)
	if len(args) == 1 && (args[0] == "--help" || args[0] == "-h" || args[0] == "help") {
		_, err := io.WriteString(writer, usage)
		return errors.Join(err, ctx.Err(), writer.Err())
	}
	err := (command{ctx: ctx, output: writer}).run(args)
	return errors.Join(err, ctx.Err(), writer.Err())
}
